items.name: HL·08 Supplier form (Zapier side)
items.what: The Zapier end of the supplier sign-up edge: each Google Form submission is POSTed as the six-field JSON from the data contract to the n8n webhook hl-supplier with the shared secret header x-hl-secret; n8n validates, stores it as pending and asks Tolu to approve. If the POST fails, an error-handler step reports it to HL·00 Errors.
steps: 1 · Trigger · Google Forms › New Form Response: Form = Harvest Lane supplier sign-up (questions: Business name, Contact name, Phone, Email, Products you supply, Area), owned and edited by Tolu's assistant.

2 · Action · Webhooks by Zapier › POST (rename "Send to n8n HL·08"): URL = https://YOUR_N8N_DOMAIN/webhook/hl-supplier; Payload Type = json; Data: business_name = [1. Business name]; contact_name = [1. Contact name]; phone = [1. Phone]; email = [1. Email]; products = [1. Products you supply]; area = [1. Area]; Wrap Request In Array = No; Unflatten = Yes; Headers: x-hl-secret = YOUR_HL_EDGE_SECRET, Content-Type = application/json.

2 · Error handler on step 2 (Custom error handling, paid plans) · Webhooks by Zapier › POST ("Report to HL·00"): URL = https://YOUR_N8N_DOMAIN/webhook/hl-errors; Payload Type = json; Data: workflow = HL·08 Supplier form; step = Send to n8n HL·08; message = the error message pill from step 2; url = the Zap history link (or the Zap's editor link typed in); order_id left empty; platform = Zapier; Headers: x-hl-secret = YOUR_HL_EDGE_SECRET.
setup: Webhooks by Zapier and custom error handling need a paid plan (Professional or up).
Build the Google Form with exactly the six questions above; Tolu's assistant can change wording but not remove a question without telling the builder (it is part of the data contract).
On the n8n side, import HL·08 Supplier form (n8n side) and HL·00 Errors from this lesson's templates and set HL_EDGE_SECRET on the server.

Paste the same secret value into the x-hl-secret header of both POST steps; it lives only in the n8n environment and this Zap, never in the form, documents or exports. Replace YOUR_N8N_DOMAIN with your n8n domain.
If custom error handling isn't on your plan, turn on Zapier's error notification emails for this Zap and route them to the alert channel instead.
Test each step, name the Zap HL·08 Supplier form and publish. Share it from the Zap's menu → Share.
items.test: End-to-end test 9: submit the form with test data (e.g. Farmgate Supplies, +2348000000000, tomatoes and peppers, Bodija): n8n answers 200, a pending row appears in suppliers and Tolu gets an Approve/Reject message on Telegram. Change the header to a wrong value in a test copy: n8n answers 400 and logs edge_rejected, step 2 errors in Zap history, and the error handler sends an alert through HL·00 Errors.
items.tasks: One task per supplier submission (the POST), plus one more only when the error handler fires; a few runs a month.
